> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT REMINDER:**
> Productive Hub is strictly **100% offline**. Feature requests requiring `android.permission.INTERNET`, cloud syncing, remote analytics, or server backends cannot and will not be accepted.

### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I find it hard to track...")

### Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the feature should behave.

### Describe Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

### UI / UX Mockup or Thoughts
Any ideas on how this should look in Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and across Xbox Dark / Light / System themes?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, design links, or notes about the feature request here.
